title: 헷갈리는 말 구별하기: 가르치다? 가리키다?
objective: You can choose the right word in five confusing pairs (such as 부치다/붙이다 and 참다/견디다) and use it in a short sentence.
summary: Learn five pairs of Korean verbs that look, sound, or mean nearly the same, and how to tell each pair apart.

task.title: Choose and use the right word
task.line: For each item, pick or write the word from the pair that fits the meaning, and use the correct form.

words.meaning: to teach (knowledge or a skill to someone)
words.exampleMeaning: I taught my friend how to cook Korean food.

words.meaning: to point at, to indicate (with a finger, a sign, or clock hands)
words.example: 시계가 벌써 열두 시를 가리키고 있어요.
words.exampleMeaning: The clock is already showing twelve.

words.meaning: to guess or answer correctly; to get (an answer) right
words.exampleMeaning: I got every quiz answer right!

words.meaning: to compare two things or make them match (answers, times, sizes)
words.example: 시험이 끝나고 친구하고 답을 맞춰 봤어요.
words.exampleMeaning: After the exam, my friend and I compared our answers.

words.meaning: to send (a letter or package) by mail
words.exampleMeaning: I mailed a package home from the post office.

words.meaning: to stick, to attach (something onto a surface)
words.exampleMeaning: Put a stamp on the envelope.

words.meaning: to get better, to recover (from an illness); forms: 나아요, 나았어요
to give birth to, to have (a baby)
words.exampleMeaning: My older sister had a baby last month.

words.meaning: to hold back, to keep in (a feeling or bodily urge in the moment)
words.exampleMeaning: It was really hard not to laugh.

words.meaning: to get through, to bear (a hard situation over time); to withstand
words.exampleMeaning: The first year was lonely, but I got through it.

exercises: Choose the right word: ① 선생님이 칠판의 글자를 손가락으로 (가르쳤어요 / 가리켰어요). ② 저는 주말마다 아이들에게 수영을 (가르쳐요 / 가리켜요).
Choose the right word: ① 동생이 제 나이를 한 번에 (맞혔어요 / 맞췄어요). ② 한국에 도착해서 시계를 한국 시간에 (맞혔어요 / 맞췄어요).
Fill in the blank with 부치다 or 붙이다 in the right form: ① 냉장고 문에 메모를 ____ 두었어요. ② 이 편지를 항공 우편으로 ____ 싶어요.
Choose the right word: ① 회의 중에 하품을 (참느라 / 견디느라) 힘들었어요. ② 이 나무는 추운 겨울도 잘 (참아요 / 견뎌요).
Answer your friend in Korean, using the word in brackets: ① 친구: 감기는 좀 어때요? (낫다) ② 친구: 수수께끼 답 알았어요? (맞히다)
answers: ① 이제 다 나았어요. (많이 나았어요. / 거의 나았어요.) ② 네, 제가 맞혔어요. (아니요, 못 맞혔어요.)
